stories.title: Flintshire council still waiting for legal advice on its own rule changes
stories.summary: The monitoring officer needs independent advice this week for a report to full council on 2 December, after changes to call-ins and debate time limits.

stories.title: MS tells First Minister 1,027 people died waiting for AE in north Wales between 2023 and 2025
stories.summary: Janet Finch-Saunders told the Senedd patients at Ysbyty Glan Clwyd spent around 10 hours in corridors on average last year. The First Minister did not commit to monthly corridor care figures.

stories.title: Ground rents to be capped at £250 under new leasehold law covering Wales
stories.summary: Ground rents would be capped at £250 a year under a new law covering 235,000 leasehold homes in Wales, which goes before Parliament on Thursday 19 November. stories.title: Flint power cut: SP Energy Networks aiming to restore supply by 2.30am
stories.summary: SP Energy Networks is aiming to have power back on by 2.24am for part of Flint hit by an unplanned power cut tonight (Wednesday 18 November). stories.title: Flint High School shut on Thursday after boiler breaks down
stories.summary: Flint High School will be closed to all pupils on Thursday 19 November after the school’s boiler broke down. The school said: Our school boiler is currently down. We have no heating and the canteen are unable to prepare hot food. It said: For safety reasons, Flint High School will be closed to all students
